The main plate is a square side plate about 22 cm across. The white pile covers roughly 12 x 14 cm and is about 3 cm high. It has chunky, irregular, soft pieces with no browning or sheen, and no yolk. That points to cooked egg white scrambled or chopped rather than cheese crumbles. Paneer or feta would look more opaque and firm, and this looks like egg white.

For weight, the pile is roughly 12 x 14 cm at a loose, uneven 2.5 cm height. That gives about 250 ml of loose volume. Chunky egg white packs at about 0.6 to 0.7 g/ml, so I estimate about 160 g.

The partial plate on the left holds roasted sweet potato or carrot pieces and grapes. Only a small part of it is visible, so I estimate about 60 g of sweet potato at about 120 kcal/100 g and about 30 g of dark grapes at about 65 kcal/100 g.
